assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
There is concern for intermittent arrhythmia as the underlying etiology of the collapse events
The cardiac event monitoring is intended to capture rhythm data during symptomatic periods
The cardiac event monitoring is intended to establish a correlation between symptoms and arrhythmia
The claim addresses the payer's denial under PR-204
The patient has a diagnosis of atherosclerotic heart disease coded I25.10
The patient has a diagnosis of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency coded I34.0
The claim is for Cardiac Event Monitoring (CPT 93271)
The service is denied under Reason Code PR-204
